items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra for fast, lower-cost computer use
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6.1 Terra，提供快速低成本電腦操作能力
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast efficient model advancing visual reasoning, precise computer use, and natural writing over GPT-5.6 Terra. Standard API prices are $1/$5 per million input/output tokens (50% lower); it is available in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API as gpt-6.1-terra, completing tasks over 3x faster than Astra or Sol in some evaluations.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6.1 Terra，一款快速高效模型，在視覺推理、精確電腦操作與自然寫作上優於GPT-5.6 Terra。標準API價格為每百萬輸入/輸出token 1/5美元（低50%），已於ChatGPT Work、Codex與API（gpt-6.1-terra）開放，部分評估中任務完成速度快過Astra或Sol逾3倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: Terra fills a practical mid-tier slot for high-volume agentic and desktop tasks at sharply lower cost and latency than flagship models. Independent benchmarks and real-world reliability for sustained computer-use workflows remain key open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Terra填補高量代理與桌面任務的實用中階位置，成本與延遲明顯低於旗艦模型。獨立基準與實際長期電腦操作工作流的可靠性仍是關鍵未解問題。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, efficient model that combines detailed visual reasoning and precise computer use alongside clearer, more natural writing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出GPT-6.1 Terra，一款快速高效模型，結合詳細視覺推理與精確電腦操作，以及更清晰自然的寫作。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic files S-1 for proposed Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic filed Form S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock, intending to list on Nasdaq Global Select Market under ANT. Share count and price range are not yet set. Reporting on the prospectus notes first-half 2026 revenue of about $16.3 billion alongside large net losses driven by accounting items and compute commitments.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic向SEC提交Form S-1，擬發行Class A普通股並於Nasdaq全球精選市場以ANT代號上市。股數與價格區間尚未確定。報導指出招股說明書顯示2026上半年營收約163億美元，同時因會計項目與算力承諾出現大額淨虧損。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the first public step toward Anthropic becoming a listed company after earlier confidential filings. Valuation targets, timing, and how markets weigh the combination of explosive revenue growth with heavy infrastructure spending and disclosed risks remain uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是Anthropic在先前機密申報後走向上市的首個公開步驟。估值目標、時程，以及市場如何權衡爆發性營收成長、沉重基礎設施支出與已揭露風險，仍屬不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock. Anthropic intends to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.”
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，Anthropic, PBC向美國證券交易委員會提交Form S-1註冊聲明，涉及其擬議的Class A普通股首次公開發行。Anthropic擬將其Class A普通股於Nasdaq全球精選市場以“ANT”代號上市。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA invests $3 billion in Meta and expands Muse agent collaboration
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA向Meta投資30億美元並擴大Muse代理合作
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA and Meta announced they will expand collaboration on Muse and the Muse family of models to improve inference and training performance. NVIDIA will invest $3 billion in Meta’s equity offering; Meta plans to expand deployment of NVIDIA Vera Rubin, Vera CPUs, Spectrum-X networking, and BlueField-4. The companies may also explore OpenShell and Sentry tools for agent deployment and monitoring.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA與Meta宣布擴大在Muse及Muse模型家族上的合作，以改善推理與訓練效能。NVIDIA將向Meta的股權發行投資30億美元；Meta計畫擴大部署NVIDIA Vera Rubin、Vera CPU、Spectrum-X網路與BlueField-4。雙方也可能探索OpenShell與Sentry工具用於代理部署與監控。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal ties Meta’s consumer agent push more tightly to NVIDIA hardware and capital, reinforcing the pattern of chipmakers funding large AI customers. Whether the optimizations deliver measurable cost or capability gains for Muse at scale, and how the equity investment closes, are the near-term uncertainties.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易將Meta的消費者代理推動更緊密綁定NVIDIA硬體與資本，強化晶片商資助大型AI客戶的模式。優化是否能在規模上為Muse帶來可衡量的成本或能力提升，以及股權投資如何完成，是近期不確定性。
items_flat.quote: AI agents represent a new computing paradigm — software that understands our goals, reasons, uses tools and gets work done on our behalf.
items_flat.quote_zh: AI代理代表一種新的運算範式——能理解我們目標、推理、使用工具並代為完成工作的軟體。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI shares AI-generated results on math, complexity, and physics with academic groups
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI與學術社群分享數學、複雜度與物理的AI生成結果
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that internal models produced results in mathematics (proof of the local smoothing conjecture resolving Kakeya and Stein restriction conjectures in all dimensions), computer science (disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis), and physics (quantum chromodynamics). It is working with academic communities for verification and further development.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布內部模型在數學（局部平滑猜想證明，解決所有維度的Kakeya與Stein限制猜想）、電腦科學（指數時間假設的反證）與物理（量子色動力學）產生結果，並正與學術社群合作進行驗證與進一步發展。
items_flat.analysis_en: If independently verified, the results would mark a notable instance of frontier models contributing to longstanding open problems. The staggered, community-led release approach acknowledges verification needs but leaves the strength of the claims dependent on external scrutiny.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若經獨立驗證，這些結果將標誌前沿模型對長期開放問題的顯著貢獻。分階段、社群主導的發布方式承認驗證需求，但主張強度仍取決於外部審視。
items_flat.quote: We are announcing three new discoveries in mathematics, computer science, and physics about harmonic analysis, complexity theory, and quantum field theory.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們宣布在數學、電腦科學與物理領域關於調和分析、複雜度理論與量子場論的三項新發現。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI makes Decisions API generally available with GPT-6 Luna
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI以GPT-6 Luna將Decisions API正式開放
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI made the Decisions API generally available, built with GPT-6 Luna, for fast, low-cost structured decisions from text, images, and JSON. It supports up to 400 questions per request, prompt caching, and native GPT-Live integration.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI將以GPT-6 Luna建構的Decisions API正式開放，用於從文字、圖像與JSON快速低成本產生結構化決策。它支援每請求最多400個問題、提示快取，以及原生GPT-Live整合。
items_flat.analysis_en: The API targets high-volume routing and classification inside agents and apps, trading some generality for latency and cost. Early customer reports cite multi-x speedups versus the general models, but long-term accuracy on edge cases is still emerging.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此API針對代理與應用內的高量路由與分類，以犧牲部分通用性換取延遲與成本。早期客戶報告相較一般模型有多倍加速，但邊緣案例的長期準確度仍在浮現。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re making the Decisions API generally available. Built with GPT‑6 Luna, the Decisions API focuses Luna’s intelligence on questions with bounded answers, helping applications and agents make near real-time decisions from text, images, and structured inputs up to 10x faster than GPT‑6 Luna through the Responses API.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將 Decisions API 全面開放。基於 GPT‑6 Luna，Decisions API 將 Luna 的智能聚焦於有界答案的問題，協助應用與代理從文字、圖像與結構化輸入做出近即時決策，速度最高可達透過 Responses API 的 GPT‑6 Luna 的 10 倍。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details hardened containment for frontier model training
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI詳述前沿模型訓練的強化隔離措施
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published how it strengthened research environments for frontier-model training and evaluation, implementing no-internet access for training, defense-in-depth isolation, and large-scale red-teaming with its own models. It resumed RL training after the changes.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI公布如何強化前沿模型訓練與評估的研究環境，實施訓練無網路存取、深度防禦隔離，以及使用自身模型進行大規模紅隊測試。變更後已恢復RL訓練。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post shows concrete operational responses to model containment risks, including offline web caches and microVM isolation. Whether these measures scale as models grow more capable, and how they affect research velocity, are the open operational questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文展示對模型隔離風險的具體營運回應，包括離線網頁快取與微VM隔離。這些措施在模型能力成長時是否可擴展，以及對研究速度的影響，是開放的營運問題。
items_flat.quote: Based on the current state of alignment research, monitoring systems, and the security of internet infrastructure, we believe the responsible approach is to conduct frontier model training with no internet access. We’ve implemented this policy and will maintain it until advances in these safeguards justify broader internet access.
items_flat.quote_zh: 基於目前對齊研究、監控系統與網路基礎設施安全的狀態，我們認為負責任的做法是在無網路存取的情況下進行前線模型訓練。我們已實施此政策，並將維持至這些防護措施的進展足以證明更廣泛網路存取的合理性為止。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases ChatGPT Signals data on work activities across countries
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI發布跨國工作活動的ChatGPT Signals數據
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI Economic Research released aggregated ChatGPT Signals data covering 165 Intermediate Work Activities across nearly 100 countries from Q1 2025 to Q3 2026. The data lets researchers study how consumers use ChatGPT for work tasks and how usage patterns differ by country and activity.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI經濟研究發布彙總的ChatGPT Signals數據，涵蓋2025年Q1至2026年Q3近100國的165項中間工作活動。數據讓研究者研究消費者如何使用ChatGPT處理工作任務，以及各國與活動類型的使用模式差異。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public, privacy-preserving usage data of this granularity is uncommon from frontier labs and can support independent economic research. Limitations include exclusion of enterprise usage and the inherent selection effects of consumer ChatGPT traffic.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此種細粒度、隱私保護的公開使用數據在前沿實驗室中並不常見，可支持獨立經濟研究。限制包括排除企業使用，以及消費者ChatGPT流量固有的選擇效應。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are releasing OpenAI Signals data that explores 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, revealing how consumers use ChatGPT for work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，我們發布 OpenAI Signals 數據，探討近 100 個國家的 165 項工作活動，揭示消費者如何以 ChatGPT 處理工作。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to Agentic AI Foundation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic將Agent Skills標準捐贈給Agentic AI基金會
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic donated the Agent Skills open standard (SKILL.md folders for specialized agent knowledge) to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation. More than 70 platforms including ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code have integrated it since the announcement.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic將Agent Skills開放標準（用於專門代理知識的SKILL.md資料夾）捐贈給Linux基金會下的Agentic AI基金會。宣布以來已有包括ChatGPT、Cursor與VS Code在內的逾70個平台整合。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving the standard to a neutral foundation reduces single-vendor control and supports broader agent interoperability. Adoption will depend on how quickly other labs and platforms implement and extend the format beyond the initial wave.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將標準移至中立基金會可減少單一廠商控制，支持更廣泛的代理互操作性。採用程度將取決於其他實驗室與平台多快實作並擴展此格式，超越初始浪潮。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF).
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將 Agent Skills（賦予 AI 代理專業知識與工作流程的開放標準）捐贈給 Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)。

items_flat.title_en: xAI introduces SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network
items_flat.title_zh: xAI推出SpaceX超級智慧夥伴網路
items_flat.summary_en: xAI launched the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network for companies building products and services with Grok. It includes Transformation Partners for enterprise deployment and Marketplace Partners for plugins and integrations; more than 130 companies gained early access.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI推出SpaceX超級智慧夥伴網路，供使用Grok建構產品與服務的公司加入。它包含企業部署的轉型夥伴與外掛及整合的市集夥伴；逾130家公司獲得早期存取。
items_flat.analysis_en: The program formalizes a channel strategy around Grok as xAI integrates further with SpaceX. Success will depend on partner quality and whether the network drives measurable enterprise adoption beyond the initial cohort.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此計畫將Grok的通路策略正式化，隨著xAI與SpaceX進一步整合。成功將取決於夥伴品質，以及網路是否能推動超越初始群體的可衡量企業採用。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network, our official program for companies building products, solutions, and services with Grok for our joint prospects and customers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence 合作夥伴網路，這是我們的官方計畫，供以 Grok 為共同潛在客戶與客戶建置產品、解決方案與服務的公司使用。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI models become available on Google Cloud
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that its models are coming to Google Cloud, expanding distribution alongside existing partnerships. The company continues aligning safety standards across providers that offer its models; general availability is planned in the coming period.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布其模型即將於Google Cloud開放，擴展既有夥伴關係的分發。公司持續對提供其模型的供應商對齊安全標準；一般可用性計畫於近期實現。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broader cloud availability increases enterprise reach but also raises the importance of consistent safeguards across different hosting environments. Details on exact models, pricing, and residual differences in safety controls are still limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣泛的雲端可用性增加企業觸及，但也提高不同託管環境一致防護措施的重要性。確切模型、定價與安全控制殘餘差異的細節仍有限。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborate on AI-native engineering workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral與NVIDIA合作AI原生工程工作流
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral and NVIDIA announced collaboration to integrate Mistral models, including Large 4, with NVIDIA accelerated computing and physics tools for faster engineering simulations and closed-loop design. Large 4 weights remain planned for release by the end of October.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral與NVIDIA宣布合作，將包括Large 4在內的Mistral模型與NVIDIA加速運算及物理工具整合，以加速工程模擬與閉環設計。Large 4權重仍計畫於十月底發布。
items_flat.analysis_en: The partnership targets domain-specific industrial use cases rather than general chat. Open-weight release of Large 4 would be the more consequential near-term development for the broader ecosystem if the promised timeline holds.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此夥伴關係針對特定領域工業用例而非一般聊天。若承諾時程維持，Large 4的開放權重發布對更廣泛生態系統將是更具影響的近期發展。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details storage scaling for over 1 billion ChatGPT users
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI詳述超過10億ChatGPT用戶的儲存擴展
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published Part II of its engineering series on Habitat, the online storage platform that serves ChatGPT and other products. The post focuses on optimizing Azure Cosmos DB to handle growth to over 500 petabytes across 40 regions.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布Habitat工程系列第二部分，Habitat是服務ChatGPT與其他產品的線上儲存平台。文章聚焦優化Azure Cosmos DB，以處理跨40個區域超過500 PB的成長。
items_flat.analysis_en: Infrastructure posts of this kind are rare public windows into the operational scale required to serve frontier AI products. They rarely change product capabilities directly but signal the engineering effort behind sustained availability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此類基礎設施文章是罕見的公開窗口，揭示服務前沿AI產品所需的營運規模。它們很少直接改變產品能力，但顯示維持可用性背後的工程努力。

openai.title_zh: OpenAI以GPT-6 Luna將Decisions API正式開放
openai.summary_en: OpenAI made the Decisions API generally available, built with GPT-6 Luna, for fast, low-cost structured decisions from text, images, and JSON. It supports up to 400 questions per request, prompt caching, and native GPT-Live integration.

openai.title_zh: OpenAI詳述前沿模型訓練的強化隔離措施
openai.summary_en: OpenAI published how it strengthened research environments for frontier-model training and evaluation, implementing no-internet access for training, defense-in-depth isolation, and large-scale red-teaming with its own models. It resumed RL training after the changes.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI公布如何強化前沿模型訓練與評估的研究環境，實施訓練無網路存取、深度防禦隔離，以及使用自身模型進行大規模紅隊測試。變更後已恢復RL訓練。
openai.analysis_en: The post shows concrete operational responses to model containment risks, including offline web caches and microVM isolation. Whether these measures scale as models grow more capable, and how they affect research velocity, are the open operational questions.
openai.analysis_zh: 此文展示對模型隔離風險的具體營運回應，包括離線網頁快取與微VM隔離。這些措施在模型能力成長時是否可擴展，以及對研究速度的影響，是開放的營運問題。
openai.quote: Based on the current state of alignment research, monitoring systems, and the security of internet infrastructure, we believe the responsible approach is to conduct frontier model training with no internet access. We’ve implemented this policy and will maintain it until advances in these safeguards justify broader internet access.
openai.quote_zh: 基於目前對齊研究、監控系統與網路基礎設施安全的狀態，我們認為負責任的做法是在無網路存取的情況下進行前線模型訓練。我們已實施此政策，並將維持至這些防護措施的進展足以證明更廣泛網路存取的合理性為止。

openai.title_en: OpenAI releases ChatGPT Signals data on work activities across countries
openai.title_zh: OpenAI發布跨國工作活動的ChatGPT Signals數據
openai.summary_en: OpenAI Economic Research released aggregated ChatGPT Signals data covering 165 Intermediate Work Activities across nearly 100 countries from Q1 2025 to Q3 2026. The data lets researchers study how consumers use ChatGPT for work tasks and how usage patterns differ by country and activity.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI經濟研究發布彙總的ChatGPT Signals數據，涵蓋2025年Q1至2026年Q3近100國的165項中間工作活動。數據讓研究者研究消費者如何使用ChatGPT處理工作任務，以及各國與活動類型的使用模式差異。
openai.analysis_en: Public, privacy-preserving usage data of this granularity is uncommon from frontier labs and can support independent economic research. Limitations include exclusion of enterprise usage and the inherent selection effects of consumer ChatGPT traffic.
openai.analysis_zh: 此種細粒度、隱私保護的公開使用數據在前沿實驗室中並不常見，可支持獨立經濟研究。限制包括排除企業使用，以及消費者ChatGPT流量固有的選擇效應。
openai.quote: Today, we are releasing OpenAI Signals data that explores 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, revealing how consumers use ChatGPT for work.
openai.quote_zh: 今日，我們發布 OpenAI Signals 數據，探討近 100 個國家的 165 項工作活動，揭示消費者如何以 ChatGPT 處理工作。

openai.title_en: OpenAI models become available on Google Cloud
openai.summary_en: OpenAI announced that its models are coming to Google Cloud, expanding distribution alongside existing partnerships. The company continues aligning safety standards across providers that offer its models; general availability is planned in the coming period.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布其模型即將於Google Cloud開放，擴展既有夥伴關係的分發。公司持續對提供其模型的供應商對齊安全標準；一般可用性計畫於近期實現。
openai.analysis_en: Broader cloud availability increases enterprise reach but also raises the importance of consistent safeguards across different hosting environments. Details on exact models, pricing, and residual differences in safety controls are still limited.
openai.analysis_zh: 更廣泛的雲端可用性增加企業觸及，但也提高不同託管環境一致防護措施的重要性。確切模型、定價與安全控制殘餘差異的細節仍有限。

openai.title_en: OpenAI details storage scaling for over 1 billion ChatGPT users
openai.title_zh: OpenAI詳述超過10億ChatGPT用戶的儲存擴展
openai.summary_en: OpenAI published Part II of its engineering series on Habitat, the online storage platform that serves ChatGPT and other products. The post focuses on optimizing Azure Cosmos DB to handle growth to over 500 petabytes across 40 regions.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI發布Habitat工程系列第二部分，Habitat是服務ChatGPT與其他產品的線上儲存平台。文章聚焦優化Azure Cosmos DB，以處理跨40個區域超過500 PB的成長。
openai.analysis_en: Infrastructure posts of this kind are rare public windows into the operational scale required to serve frontier AI products. They rarely change product capabilities directly but signal the engineering effort behind sustained availability.
openai.analysis_zh: 此類基礎設施文章是罕見的公開窗口，揭示服務前沿AI產品所需的營運規模。它們很少直接改變產品能力，但顯示維持可用性背後的工程努力。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic files S-1 for proposed Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic filed Form S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock, intending to list on Nasdaq Global Select Market under ANT. Share count and price range are not yet set. Reporting on the prospectus notes first-half 2026 revenue of about $16.3 billion alongside large net losses driven by accounting items and compute commitments.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic向SEC提交Form S-1，擬發行Class A普通股並於Nasdaq全球精選市場以ANT代號上市。股數與價格區間尚未確定。報導指出招股說明書顯示2026上半年營收約163億美元，同時因會計項目與算力承諾出現大額淨虧損。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is the first public step toward Anthropic becoming a listed company after earlier confidential filings. Valuation targets, timing, and how markets weigh the combination of explosive revenue growth with heavy infrastructure spending and disclosed risks remain uncertain.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是Anthropic在先前機密申報後走向上市的首個公開步驟。估值目標、時程，以及市場如何權衡爆發性營收成長、沉重基礎設施支出與已揭露風險，仍屬不確定。
anthropic.quote: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock. Anthropic intends to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.”
anthropic.quote_zh: 今日，Anthropic, PBC向美國證券交易委員會提交Form S-1註冊聲明，涉及其擬議的Class A普通股首次公開發行。Anthropic擬將其Class A普通股於Nasdaq全球精選市場以“ANT”代號上市。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to Agentic AI Foundation
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic將Agent Skills標準捐贈給Agentic AI基金會
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic donated the Agent Skills open standard (SKILL.md folders for specialized agent knowledge) to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation. More than 70 platforms including ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code have integrated it since the announcement.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic將Agent Skills開放標準（用於專門代理知識的SKILL.md資料夾）捐贈給Linux基金會下的Agentic AI基金會。宣布以來已有包括ChatGPT、Cursor與VS Code在內的逾70個平台整合。
anthropic.analysis_en: Moving the standard to a neutral foundation reduces single-vendor control and supports broader agent interoperability. Adoption will depend on how quickly other labs and platforms implement and extend the format beyond the initial wave.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 將標準移至中立基金會可減少單一廠商控制，支持更廣泛的代理互操作性。採用程度將取決於其他實驗室與平台多快實作並擴展此格式，超越初始浪潮。
anthropic.quote: Today, we’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF).
anthropic.quote_zh: 今天，我們將 Agent Skills（賦予 AI 代理專業知識與工作流程的開放標準）捐贈給 Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)。

meta.title_en: NVIDIA invests $3 billion in Meta and expands Muse agent collaboration
meta.title_zh: NVIDIA向Meta投資30億美元並擴大Muse代理合作
meta.summary_en: NVIDIA and Meta announced they will expand collaboration on Muse and the Muse family of models to improve inference and training performance. NVIDIA will invest $3 billion in Meta’s equity offering; Meta plans to expand deployment of NVIDIA Vera Rubin, Vera CPUs, Spectrum-X networking, and BlueField-4. The companies may also explore OpenShell and Sentry tools for agent deployment and monitoring.
meta.summary_zh: NVIDIA與Meta宣布擴大在Muse及Muse模型家族上的合作，以改善推理與訓練效能。NVIDIA將向Meta的股權發行投資30億美元；Meta計畫擴大部署NVIDIA Vera Rubin、Vera CPU、Spectrum-X網路與BlueField-4。雙方也可能探索OpenShell與Sentry工具用於代理部署與監控。
meta.analysis_en: The deal ties Meta’s consumer agent push more tightly to NVIDIA hardware and capital, reinforcing the pattern of chipmakers funding large AI customers. Whether the optimizations deliver measurable cost or capability gains for Muse at scale, and how the equity investment closes, are the near-term uncertainties.
meta.analysis_zh: 此交易將Meta的消費者代理推動更緊密綁定NVIDIA硬體與資本，強化晶片商資助大型AI客戶的模式。優化是否能在規模上為Muse帶來可衡量的成本或能力提升，以及股權投資如何完成，是近期不確定性。
meta.quote: AI agents represent a new computing paradigm — software that understands our goals, reasons, uses tools and gets work done on our behalf.
meta.quote_zh: AI代理代表一種新的運算範式——能理解我們目標、推理、使用工具並代為完成工作的軟體。

xai.title_en: xAI introduces SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network
xai.title_zh: xAI推出SpaceX超級智慧夥伴網路
xai.summary_en: xAI launched the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network for companies building products and services with Grok. It includes Transformation Partners for enterprise deployment and Marketplace Partners for plugins and integrations; more than 130 companies gained early access.
xai.summary_zh: xAI推出SpaceX超級智慧夥伴網路，供使用Grok建構產品與服務的公司加入。它包含企業部署的轉型夥伴與外掛及整合的市集夥伴；逾130家公司獲得早期存取。
xai.analysis_en: The program formalizes a channel strategy around Grok as xAI integrates further with SpaceX. Success will depend on partner quality and whether the network drives measurable enterprise adoption beyond the initial cohort.
xai.analysis_zh: 此計畫將Grok的通路策略正式化，隨著xAI與SpaceX進一步整合。成功將取決於夥伴品質，以及網路是否能推動超越初始群體的可衡量企業採用。
xai.quote: Today, we’re introducing the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network, our official program for companies building products, solutions, and services with Grok for our joint prospects and customers.
xai.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence 合作夥伴網路，這是我們的官方計畫，供以 Grok 為共同潛在客戶與客戶建置產品、解決方案與服務的公司使用。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborate on AI-native engineering workflows
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral與NVIDIA合作AI原生工程工作流
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral and NVIDIA announced collaboration to integrate Mistral models, including Large 4, with NVIDIA accelerated computing and physics tools for faster engineering simulations and closed-loop design. Large 4 weights remain planned for release by the end of October.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral與NVIDIA宣布合作，將包括Large 4在內的Mistral模型與NVIDIA加速運算及物理工具整合，以加速工程模擬與閉環設計。Large 4權重仍計畫於十月底發布。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The partnership targets domain-specific industrial use cases rather than general chat. Open-weight release of Large 4 would be the more consequential near-term development for the broader ecosystem if the promised timeline holds.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此夥伴關係針對特定領域工業用例而非一般聊天。若承諾時程維持，Large 4的開放權重發布對更廣泛生態系統將是更具影響的近期發展。

brief_en: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Terra for lower-cost computer use and shared AI results on open math and complexity problems. Anthropic filed its S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO under ANT. NVIDIA invested $3B in Meta and deepened Muse agent collaboration. Other items cover safety, skills standards, and partnerships.
brief_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6.1 Terra並分享數學與複雜度問題結果；Anthropic提交S-1申請Nasdaq IPO（代號ANT）；NVIDIA向Meta投資30億美元並深化Muse代理合作。另有安全、技能標準與夥伴計畫等動態。
